User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must be coerced into decompressing a malicious video. The specific flaw exists within the decompression of a specific type of video stream contained in an .AVI file. The application misuses a length field for an allocation causing the memory allocation to be too small to contain the subsequent data. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must be coerced into decompressing a malicious video. The specific flaw exists within the decompression of a specific type of video stream contained in an .AVI file.
